entities.summary: Tanger Med is a Moroccan industrial port complex, located 45 km northeast of Tangier and opposite Tarifa, Spain on the Strait of Gibraltar, with handling capacities of 11 million containers, one of the largest industrial ports in the world, and the largest port in Africa and the Mediterranean Sea. 7 million passengers, 700,000 trucks and the export of 1 million vehicles.
